name: MEMORY
description: Memory (Concentration) is a domino adaptation of the card game Pelmanism. All double-6 tiles are laid face down in a 4×7 grid. On your turn you turn up two tiles; if they total 12 you remove them and take another turn; otherwise you turn them face down and the next player goes. The first to capture 50 tiles (25 pairs) or an agreed total wins. It is a test of memory.

content.text: Memory (Concentration) is a domino adaptation of the card game Pelmanism. All double-6 tiles are laid face down in a 4×7 grid. On your turn you turn up two tiles; if they total 12 you remove them and take another turn; otherwise you turn them face down and the next player goes. The first to capture 50 tiles (25 pairs) or an agreed total wins. It is a test of memory.

Concentration is an adaptation for dominoes of the card game Pelmanism, also known as Concentration or Memory. The card version originated in Europe; the domino version follows the same memory-matching principle with tiles laid in a grid. The game is also the basis for a popular American television quiz show using pairs of prizes.

Minimum Players: 2
